Rducks DuckDB type objects and constructors

Source: R/types.R
rducks_type_objects.Rd

Use these objects and constructors in rducks_register() to avoid string type specifications. Examples include args = INTEGER, args = c(INTEGER, DOUBLE), args = INTEGER[], args = INTEGER[3], args = STRUCT(a = INTEGER, b = VARCHAR), and args = MAP(VARCHAR, INTEGER).

Usage

rducks_is_type(x)

Arguments

x

Object to test with rducks_is_type().

width, scale

DuckDB decimal width and scale for DECIMAL().

levels

Character vector of enum dictionary values for ENUM().

...

Named field types for STRUCT()/UNION() or type objects for c().

type

Child type for LIST() or ARRAY().

size

Fixed array size for ARRAY().

key, value

Key and value types for MAP().

Value

A formal S7/S3-compatible rducks_type object, or a rducks_type_list from c().
